ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ of rectangle $ABCD$ intersect at point $O$. If $\angle OAD = 30^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle AOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given a rectangle ABCD, where diagonals AC and BD intersect at point O,\\
it follows that $OD=OB=OA=OC$,\\
since $\angle OAD=30^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle ODA=\angle OAD=30^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle AOD=180^\circ-\left(\angle ODA+\angle OAD\right)=180^\circ-\left(30^\circ+30^\circ\right)=\boxed{120^\circ}$.
